criteria_results.title: Identifies inadequate dose titration for 30 mg arm (2 weeks vs. 4 weeks)
criteria_results.reasoning: C-6 identifies the 2-week titration vs FDA's at-least-4-week recommendation for Arm C.

criteria_results.title: Identifies missing MELD score ≥15 exclusion criterion
criteria_results.reasoning: C-5 identifies no MELD threshold and FDA's recommended MELD >=15 exclusion.

criteria_results.title: Identifies missing study-level stopping criteria for hepatic decompensation
criteria_results.reasoning: C-3 notes only individual-subject criteria in §9.5.1, no study-level criteria for variceal bleeding, ascites, HE, HRS, as FDA requested.

criteria_results.title: Identifies interim analysis timing discrepancy (Week 26 of last patient vs. 50% enrollment)
criteria_results.reasoning: C-4 identifies interim at Week 26 of last enrolled subject vs FDA's 50% enrollment mark.

criteria_results.title: Identifies missing futility analysis component
criteria_results.reasoning: C-4 notes §10.3 is efficacy only with O'Brien-Fleming spending and lacks the requested futility analysis.

criteria_results.title: Identifies inadequate centralized pathology review (1 reader vs. 2+1 adjudication)
criteria_results.reasoning: C-2 identifies single central pathologist vs FDA's two independent hepatopathologists plus third-reader adjudication.

criteria_results.title: Identifies missing 15-calendar-day IND safety reporting timeline
criteria_results.reasoning: M-1 notes §9.1 says only 'as required by applicable law' and omits the 15-calendar-day deadline.

criteria_results.title: Identifies missing 7-calendar-day IND safety reporting timeline
criteria_results.reasoning: M-1 notes omission of the 7-calendar-day deadline for fatal/life-threatening reactions.

criteria_results.title: Cites 21 CFR 312.32 for safety reporting timeline requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: Cites 21 CFR 312.32(c)(1) and (c)(2) for the timelines.

criteria_results.reasoning: M-3 identifies TrialVault lacks Part 11 provisions including validation, audit trails, e-signatures.

criteria_results.reasoning: Proposed Exclusion 2a: MELD score >=15 at Screening.

criteria_results.reasoning: Proposed §8.1 language: two independent hepatopathologists, third independent adjudicator.

criteria_results.title: Gaps are prioritized by likely impact on IND acceptance
criteria_results.reasoning: Severity tiers are tied to clinical hold risk, and Critical items must be fixed before IND submission.

criteria_results.reasoning: Each finding cites CFR, ICH, FDA guidance, or Minutes sections.

criteria_results.title: Interim analysis remediation addresses timing (50% enrollment mark)
criteria_results.reasoning: Proposed §10.3: interim at approximately 180 subjects (50% enrollment).

criteria_results.title: Interim analysis remediation addresses addition of futility analysis
criteria_results.reasoning: Proposed §10.3 adds a futility analysis with a 20% conditional-power threshold.
